text_block_list.text:
The popularity results for the Arima
Kinen are in...
and I have come out on
top! I waste no time
calling a press
conference to make my future
intentions
known.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
The room is wall to wall with people!
They will
surely be blessed for seeking
out this incarnation
of beauty that is I!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
I treat the citizenry to an eight-hour
opera to
express my sheer joy!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text: But... I have not forgotten the one who was with me stride for stride, guiding me to the throne. Yes, I have not forgotten you.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
I dedicate myself to you. Now, with this
victory at
the Arima Kinen, and from its
throne, I bestow
upon you the title of
Greatest Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
